title: GTPv2: Add NF Instance ID and Timer in Seconds IEs
description: Add a few new IEs as they are described in TS 29.274 V18.4.0.

marked this merge request as **ready**
`hf_gtpv2_spare_bytes` is a `FT_BYTES` field, the encoding must be `ENC_NA`. (Yes, that happens to coincidentally be the same value as `ENC_ASCII`, 0, but it might not always be.)
With FT_GUID the encoding should be ENC_BIG_ENDIAN
As the spare bytes belongs to a possible future extension? It is probably better to have something like "Data not decoded yet"?

changed this line in [version 5 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14875/diffs?diff_id=960803116&start_sha=c4b3270f0e74aaebf653d92e54a92dc8b44321d9#c98eae7adb877ff5751acbb4207fbd97c2f56260_8606_8614)

The standard says this about the field that I represented as spare bytes:
"These octet(s) is/are present only if explicitly specified".
So should I rather call
```
proto_tree_add_expert(tree, pinfo, &ei_gtpv2_ie_data_not_dissected, tvb, 3, length - 4);
```
here?
Yes :-)
@AndersBroman Thank you for confirming. I have changed this. I think now everything is fixed.
FT_GUID, BASE_NONE, NULL, 0x0,

changed this line in [version 5 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14875/diffs?diff_id=960803116&start_sha=c4b3270f0e74aaebf653d92e54a92dc8b44321d9#c98eae7adb877ff5751acbb4207fbd97c2f56260_12620_12628)

It would be good to add this text from TS 29.571 as a comment:
`String uniquely identifying a NF instance. The format of the NF Instance ID shall be a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) version 4, as described in IETF RFC 4122 [15]. The hexadecimal letters should be formatted as lower-case characters by the sender, and they shall be handled as case-insensitive by the receiver.
Example:
"4ace9d34-2c69-4f99-92d5-a73a3fe8e23b"
`
AS this is a UUID display it as such.
